title: The Day of the Even Trade
skyStory: The waning gibbous moon shrinks to eighty-three percent, still in Libra, and opens a little cosmic swap shop. Trade a worry for a laugh. Trade a grey morning for a bright afternoon. Saturn trades a stern look for a reluctant smile. Mars trades five half-finished ideas for one good one, and the moon declares it the bargain of the century.

reading: Your brain is holding five half-finished projects, and every one of them is waving at you from the corner of your mind like an excited puppy. The [[Knight of Wands]] has seen enough. Today, trade four of them for one.

Not forever. Just for this week. Write the other four on a list and put them in a drawer. Then aim the full fire of the Tiger at the one that remains. By Friday you will have something finished, and the drawer will still be there, waiting patiently with its puppies.
joel.mission: Write your four least urgent projects on a list, put it in a drawer, and focus on one.
joel.omen: Two people swapping something, a glove or a book or a seat. It means a good exchange is coming your way.
joel.elementWhy: aim the fire at one thing

reading: Someone will offer you a trade today, and it will be a good one. Maybe a task swapped for a favour, maybe a seat by the window swapped for one by the door. The Wood Rat weighs it in two seconds flat and knows instantly.

Take the trade. Then make one of your own: swap a familiar habit for something new, even just for the day. A different mug. A different walk. A different first sentence when you answer the phone. Libra loves a little exchange, and so do you, secretly.
nancy.mission: Swap one small habit for something new today and notice what changes, even slightly.
nancy.omen: A coin or a button on the ground. It means a fair trade is about to land in your lap.
nancy.elementWhy: steady footing in the swap shop

together.text: Trade one task with each other, just for fun. Nancy picks something for Joel to do today, Joel picks something for Nancy. Keep them small and silly: hum a tune at lunch, wear a hat indoors for an hour. The swap shop closes at midnight.
